verdict.line: You lose if Garen freely trades E and Q into you before level 6; you win if you survive to level 6+ and land the Q-into-R combo OP.GG itself flags for this matchup.

brief.thesis: Garen's passive (Perseverance) heals him back to full between skirmishes and his E (Judgment) is a short-cooldown spin he can throw out constantly, so uninterrupted trading favors him. Ornn's tools are slower to land — Q (Volcanic Rupture) has a delay before the pillar forms, and E (Searing Charge) only knocks up if it hits terrain — which is why Garen holds lane and solo-kill advantage here (47.9% Ornn win rate over 1654 games, below Ornn's 51.5% baseline). Ornn's equalizer is the ultimate: once R is live, the matchup's real win condition is the Q-slow into R-kill pattern.

theirWindow.when: Garen's E is off cooldown and he's near full
theirWindow.what: He can spin (13/12/11/10/9s cooldown) to poke you repeatedly while Perseverance heals the damage back. Don't stand in minion range trading autos with him during this window — disengage or force him to walk into your Q slow instead.

yourWindow.when: Your Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow has landed and R is up
yourWindow.what: Follow immediately with R (Call of the Forge God) and recast it to redirect the elemental into him for the knockup — this is the exact line OP.GG calls out: punish with Q, close with R, before he can Flash or Q (Decisive Strike) away.

start.why: 55.4% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two common starts (48% over 1107 games) — the extra sustain directly counters Garen's E poke and Perseverance regen race.

boots.why: 81.9% pick rate and the better of the two boot options (49.6% over 1555 games) — flat physical reduction cuts both his auto-attacks and his E spin damage.

core.why: First item on every viable build path in this data — gives you the HP and immolate pressure to punish him for standing near you.
Part of the best-performing path recorded (63.5% win rate over 52 games into Jak'Sho) — the grievous wounds and shield directly blunt his Perseverance sustain.
Closes out the strongest recorded build path and gives the resistance stacking you need once he starts one-shotting with R (Demacian Justice) at higher levels.

situational.when: garen is ahead and leaning on auto-attacks or lifesteal to close out the lane
the enemy team has a strong magic damage threat alongside garen
garen or another enemy carry is stacking crit or attack speed

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained healing on your first attack every few seconds directly offsets the damage you take absorbing his E spins and auto trades — this is the higher win-rate page recorded (53.1% over 16% of games).

summoners.why: The standard pick at 72.5% of games and a 49.1% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after losing an early trade and answer his split-push threat later, which matters more here than Ignite given you're behind in solo-kill potential.

playing.title: Trade only after his E lands
playing.detail: Step in and poke with Q (Volcanic Rupture) right after he spends E (Judgment), since its cooldown (13/12/11/10/9s) is the one window he can't immediately spin again.

playing.title: Respect his Q before committing E or R
playing.detail: Decisive Strike (8s cooldown) breaks slows and silences on his next hit — don't start a long E (Searing Charge) charge or wind up R while it's up, bait it out on minions first.

playing.title: Aim E charges at terrain
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up if you collide with terrain mid-charge, so position your charges toward walls near him rather than flat open-ground charges that deal no knockup.

playing.title: Apply W before you all-in
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final gout of flame inflicts Brittle — land it right before you commit so your Q and R follow-up hit a debuffed target instead of a clean one.

playing.title: Deny his passive regen window
playing.detail: Perseverance heals him back to full once he's gone untouched for a moment — keep poking with Q on cooldown between trades so he never gets to sit and regenerate.

playing.title: Chain Q into R for the kill
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup: slow him with Q, then summon and recast R (Call of the Forge God) to redirect the elemental into him for the knockup before he can reset with Flash or Decisive Strike.

playing.title: Play around his execute past level 11
playing.detail: Demacian Justice drops to a 50s and then 20s cooldown at ranks 4-5, meaning from level 11 on it's nearly always up — don't sit below 50% health near him.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, terrain requirements, trade timing — is my own tactical read layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] to punish Garen and kill him afterwards using [R]. Be careful of being killed when you are below 50% health as Garen can use (R) to kill you instead.
